---
title: "Cross-model agreement"
subtitle: "Where the three model families converge and where they diverge"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_data.R")
library(knitr); library(ggplot2); library(reactable)
man  <- load_manifestos()
dims <- block_dims("poplib_v4") |> filter(min == 0, max == 10)
sc   <- load_scores("poplib_v4") |> filter(model %in% c("sonnet", "gpt41mini", "gemini"), dim %in% dims$id)
wide <- sc |> select(doc_id, dim, model, score) |> pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = score)
mods <- c("sonnet", "gpt41mini", "gemini")
```

Each model is aggregated on its own (counted chunks only, confidence-weighted, as in the paper);
the tables compare the three per-manifesto scores. The paper uses their plain mean.

## Pairwise correlations by dimension

```{r cor-grid, echo=FALSE}
pairs <- combn(mods, 2, simplify = FALSE)
tab <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dims)), function(i) {
  d <- dims$id[i]; s <- wide |> filter(dim == d)
  map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
    ok <- is.finite(s[[p[1]]]) & is.finite(s[[p[2]]])
    if (sum(ok) < 30) return(NULL)
    tibble(Dimension = dims$label[i], Pair = paste(MSHORT[p], collapse = " – "), N = sum(ok),
           Pearson = round(cor(s[[p[1]]][ok], s[[p[2]]][ok]), 2),
           Spearman = round(cor(s[[p[1]]][ok], s[[p[2]]][ok], method = "spearman"), 2),
           `Mean abs. gap` = round(mean(abs(s[[p[1]]][ok] - s[[p[2]]][ok])), 2))
  })
})
reactable(tab, defaultPageSize = 10, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE, pageSizeOptions = c(10, 20, 50),
          filterable = TRUE, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE, highlight = TRUE,
          columns = list(Dimension = colDef(minWidth = 180), Pair = colDef(minWidth = 160),
                         N = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE),
                         Pearson = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE),
                         Spearman = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE),
                         `Mean abs. gap` = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE)))
```

## Largest disagreements on populism

Manifestos where two models differ by more than three points on populism (overall); open one to
see which evidence each model cited.

```{r outliers, echo=FALSE}
m <- wide |> filter(dim == "populism_overall")
m$range <- apply(m[mods], 1, function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; if (length(x) < 2) NA else diff(range(x)) })
out <- m |> filter(range > 3) |> left_join(man |> select(doc_id, countryname, partyabbrev, partyname, year), by = "doc_id") |>
  arrange(desc(range))
if (!nrow(out)) cat("*No manifesto with a gap above three points.*") else
  out |> transmute(Manifesto = sprintf('<a href="manifesto/%s.html">%s</a>', doc_id, doc_id), Country = countryname,
                   Party = coalesce(partyabbrev, partyname), Year = year,
                   Sonnet = round(sonnet, 1), `GPT-4.1-mini` = round(gpt41mini, 1), Gemini = round(gemini, 1),
                   Range = round(range, 1)) |>
  reactable(defaultPageSize = 10, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE, pageSizeOptions = c(10, 25, 100),
            filterable = TRUE, striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE, highlight = TRUE,
            defaultSorted = list(Range = "desc"),
            columns = list(Manifesto = colDef(html = TRUE, minWidth = 130), Country = colDef(minWidth = 120),
                           Party = colDef(minWidth = 110), Year = colDef(align = "center", maxWidth = 70),
                           Sonnet = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE), `GPT-4.1-mini` = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE),
                           Gemini = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE), Range = colDef(align = "center", filterable = FALSE)))
```

`r nrow(out)` manifestos in total; sort or filter the table, 10 per page.

## Score distributions

```{r dist, echo=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=10}
sc |> mutate(dim_lbl = factor(dims$label[match(dim, dims$id)], levels = dims$label),
             model = factor(MSHORT[model], levels = MSHORT[mods])) |>
  ggplot(aes(score, fill = model)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~dim_lbl, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Score (0–10)", y = "Manifestos") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
